headline: 6 Michigan deals, $25.5M raised — led by TXC Great Lakes Fund, LP

top_deals.summary: TXC Great Lakes Fund, LP, a Holland-based company, filed a Form D tied to a business combination (acquisition or merger); $43.6M of equity issued to 70 investors. (Amended filing.)
University Bancorp, Inc., an Ann Arbor-based commercial banking company, filed a $25M equity offering under Rule 506(b); $25M sold to 1 investor.
CCP Energy Fund I, LLC, a Bloomfield Hills-based company, filed a $15.9M equity offering under Rule 506(b); $500K sold to 7 investors. (Amended filing.)
Wolverine Insurance Co, a Dowagiac-based company, filed a Form D tied to a business combination (acquisition or merger); $7M of equity issued to 5 investors.
TPCN Holdings, LLC, a Bloomfield Hills-based fund, filed a Form D tied to a business combination (acquisition or merger); $706.2K of equity and pooled fund interests issued to 1 investor.

talking_points.text: Michigan issuers reported $25.5M sold across 2 Form D filings this week, down 38% vs. the prior 4-week average. The largest was University Bancorp, Inc. (Ann Arbor, Commercial Banking) targeting $25M. Good question to ask: are founders in financial services favoring equity rounds over venture debt right now?
TXC Great Lakes Fund, LP disclosed a deal. It was one of 3 M&A filings this week. Use it to ask how buyers are valuing Michigan real estate assets and whether consolidation is accelerating.

1 Michigan-based pooled fund filed Form Ds, reporting $706.2K raised so far — led by TPCN Holdings, LLC (Business Combination (Form D)). A natural opener: what are LPs asking Michigan sponsors for in today's fundraising market?
